src: table-cell 2 by 2 sprites s whose color differs from the unique full-row/full-column gridline color, grouped by color
dst: output rows d ordered top-to-bottom by increasing sprite count
match_cond: rank(s.sprite_count ascending) == rank(d top-to-bottom); counts are unique
transform: fill the leftmost s.sprite_count cells of d with s.color and leave the remaining cells background
grid_shape: height is number of counted colors; width is largest counted sprite count
